_note: Container images for GEAK CI e2e runs (repo-tracked). This is the DEFAULT preset; sibling presets live in ci/docker_setup/*.json and are selected per-run by the Actions variable vars.DOCKER_DEFAULT_JSON (a bare filename in this folder; unset -> docker_default.json). The CI resolves it to DOCKER_DEFAULT=ci/docker_setup/<name>, which lib.sh honors. resolve_image(framework, model_key) in ci/lib.sh picks in this precedence: (1) IMAGE=<repo:tag> env override; (2) models[<model_key>] — a per-model pin, either a plain string or an {arch: image} dict; (3) [framework][arch]; (4) [framework].default; (5) first image listed for the framework. The R9700 path always fails closed instead of inheriting an MI image. Identity is MI355 for gfx950, MI300 for gfx942/gfx90a, and R9700 only when exact structured product detection confirms AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700. Bare gfx1201 or RDNA4 is ISA-only and has no image-map fallback. GEAK_GPU_ARCH is allowlisted, but an explicit R9700 expectation still requires matching on-box identity. Defaults now come from the internal harbor.crusoe registry except R9700 vLLM which pins the public rocm/vllm gfx12-capable tag. NOTE: the sglang harbor image is an MI35x build, so MI300 stays on the previous primussafe mi30x 'profilerfix' image (ROCm 7.2.0) until an MI30x build of v0.5.17 is published; swap it here when one exists. There is no R9700 SGLang image — resolve_image sglang on R9700 must fail. 'models' is intentionally EMPTY — every enrolled model resolves via its framework default (framework comes from each model's handoff.json). Add a per-model pin here only to deviate from the default.
